review_method: Numeric re-measurement only: the checkout size and its date change; wording is the reviewed 2026-09-24 translation. Native-speaker signoff not claimed.

records.label: dated-clone-and-current-checkout-size
records.source: On 2026-09-15, the full clone downloaded 5.8 GB. Adding ``--filter=blob:none`` to the shallow clone did not reduce its measured download. The nightly tracked tree is a 1642 MB checkout (measured 2026-09-25), excluding Git history. Download sizes and times vary with the branch.
records.translation: Í mælingunni 2026-09-15 sótti fullt klón 5,8 GB. Í grunna klóninu minnkaði ``--filter=blob:none`` ekki mælt niðurhal. Skrárnar sem Git fylgist með í nightly taka 1642 MB í vinnutrénu (mælt 2026-09-25), án Git-ferilsins. Stærð niðurhals og tími fara eftir greininni.
